commitments.detail: Used oil drums will be picked up for recycling on 2023-10-15.
Batteries will be palletized and labeled for return to the supply chain by 2023-10-15.
Expired medical cold packs will be returned to the medical supply chain on 2023-10-20.
Empty compressed-air cylinders will be picked up on 2023-10-18 and must be upright-racked during transport.
